description: This file defines API routes for handling GitHub OAuth integration within a FastAPI application. It includes endpoints for initiating the OAuth flow, handling callbacks, verifying user membership, and securely storing access tokens and user info related to GitHub.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user_payload(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and validates user info from the Bearer token in the Authorization header.

methods.name: None _ensure_membership(conn, user_id: str, org_id: str)
methods.description: Checks whether the user is a member of the specified organization.

methods.name: RedirectResponse github_connect( request: Request, payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), redirect_uri: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Override callback URL for testing (optional)"), )
methods.description: Starts the GitHub OAuth flow by generating a state, storing it, and redirecting the user to GitHub's authorization URL.

methods.name: dict github_callback( request: Request, code: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Authorization code from GitHub"), state: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="State parameter for CSRF protection"), )
methods.description: Handles the OAuth callback by exchanging the code for an access token, verifying state, and storing token data securely.

ctags.signature: ( request: Request, code: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Authorization code from GitHub"), state: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="State parameter for CSRF protection"), )

ctags.signature: ( request: Request, payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), redirect_uri: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Override callback URL for testing (optional)"), )
